The '''Brak Sector CommNet''' was the communications network serving [[Brak sector/Legends|Brak sector]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] forces [[Attack on the Brak Sector CommNet|attacked]] the CommNet in a coordinated strike, wiping out communications in the [[Sector/Legends|sector]] until back up systems activated.
